instructions_to_main_agent: Follow Portuguese (PT-BR) language consistently for all user-facing copy, notifications, toasts, and form masks.
Ensure the booking form contains the exact requested fields: 'nome', 'cpf', 'email', 'numero', 'endereço', alongside service type ('Instalação' or 'Manutenção') and date selection.
Implement input masks or clean formatters for CPF (000.000.000-00) and Brazilian phone numbers ((00) 00000-0000).
Seed default owner credentials in memory/test_credentials.md and backend/seed.py (e.g., admin@jsclimatizacao.com.br / admin123) with pre-seeded realistic Brazilian appointments.
Public landing page MUST render gracefully if backend fails: show header, hero, service cards, contact info and offline alert without crashing.
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled gray backgrounds. Use the deep navy/obsidian #0B132B background with icy cyan highlights (#00B4D8 / #38BDF8) and frosted glass cards.
Use sonner for instant toast feedback upon booking submission, status updates, and deletions.
Provide a quick 'Falar no WhatsApp' direct link on cards or bottom floating button (+55 (11) 99999-8888 placeholder) and clear contact details in the footer.
